Telehealth with a clear purpose

Choose by clinician fit, not just proximity.

Online therapy can reduce travel and help eligible Washington clients compare clinicians by experience, approach, schedule, and service.

Clients must be physically located in Washington during appointments. Eligibility also depends on clinical circumstances, clinician availability, and applicable requirements.
